title: Herbaflow analysis contract
description: Single upstream source for analysis-domain vocabularies and pipeline-parameter bounds. Read by both stacks. The DB run-status column stays free text (composite 'stage_{N}_{phase}'); only the vocabulary is codified here.

stage_phase.description: Phase suffix in the composite status 'stage_{N}_{phase}'.

max_mw.description: Molecular weight ceiling (Da). Molecular size — larger molecules permeate membranes more poorly.

max_logp.description: Lipophilicity ceiling (logP, octanol–water partition). Balances solubility against membrane permeation.

max_hbd.description: Hydrogen-bond donor ceiling (Σ N–H, O–H). Each donor adds a desolvation penalty crossing membranes.

max_hba.description: Hydrogen-bond acceptor ceiling (Σ N, O atoms). Adds a desolvation penalty.

max_tpsa.description: Topological polar surface area ceiling (Å²). Polarity — high TPSA lowers absorption (Veber).

max_rotatable_bonds.description: Rotatable-bond ceiling. Molecular flexibility — too flexible lowers oral bioavailability (Veber).

apply_veber.description: Apply Veber's rules (rotatable bonds + TPSA) on top of Lipinski's four.

np_exception_threshold.description: Natural-product-likeness score (Ertl, approx [-5,+5]) at or above which a compound bypasses the rules — protects genuine plant compounds.

apply_np_exception.description: Allow the natural-product-likeness exception to rescue rule-breaking compounds. Off = strict (no NP rescue).

max_violations.description: Number of the four Lipinski rules a compound may break and still pass (RO5 leniency). Veber is evaluated separately, not in this budget.

skip_adme.description: Bypass ADME screening entirely — every compound passes, flagged not screened.

limits.description: App-level input bounds shared by both stacks.

max_plants.description: Maximum plants selectable for one analysis run.
